newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU July 1-Sept 3 grain export commitments fell y/y.
newsitem.headline: EU July 1-Sept 3 grain export commitments fell y/y.

text.p: Latest European Union figures show grain export commitments between July 1 and September 3 of the new 1996/97 (July/June) campaign were 48.5 percent below their year-ago level, member-country officials said on Tuesday.
The figures, based on delivered export certificates, showed grain sales plunged to 2.388 million tonnes from 4.638 million.
Commercial wheat exports fell to 600,000 tonnes from 2.058 million tonnes but heavy export commitments to China inflated wheat export figures at the start of the previous 1995/96 campaign.
Flour export commitments, however, reached 912,000 tonnes against 868,000 tonnes during the same period last year.
Commercial barley exports fell to 477,000 tonnes from 632,000 tonnes.

Since September 3, the EU granted 112,350 tonnes of soft wheat, 186,411 tonnes of barley, 50,157 tonnes of rye and 21,000 tonnes of oats through its weekly grain tender system. -- Paris newsroom +331 4221 5432
